name: CrowdStrike - Falcon Platform - Executable Written - New
description: The CrowdStrike - Executable Written Dashboard identifies the events detected by Executables Written and which engines, hosts, and usernames have dealt with high severity events in the past hour.
title: CrowdStrike - Falcon Platform - Executable Written - New

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/CrowdStrike DetectionSummaryEvent Executable Written Detection Summary
| parse "CEF:0|CrowdStrike|FalconHost|1.0|DetectionSummaryEvent|*|*|" as detect_type,sev 
| extract "suser=(?<user>.*?)(?:\s|$)" nodrop
| extract "shost=(?<host>.*?)(?:\s|$)" nodrop
| extract "fname=(?<file>.*?)(?:\s|$)" nodrop
| extract "filePath=(?<path>.*?)(?: \w+=|$)" nodrop
| extract "cs1=(?<commandline>.*?)(?: \w+=|$)" nodrop
| extract "cs2=(?<written_filename>.*?)(?: \w+=|$)" nodrop
| extract "cs3=(?<written_filepath>.*?)(?:\s|$)" nodrop
| extract "cs6=(?<FalconHostLink>.*?)(?:\s|$)" nodrop
| extract "cn3=(?<offset>.*?)(?:\s|$)" nodrop
| extract "spid=(?<spid>.*?)(?:\s|$)" nodrop
| extract "sntdom=(?<host_domain>.*?)(?:\s|$)" nodrop
| extract "deviceCustomDate1=(?<exe_written_time>.*?)(?: \w+=|$)" nodrop
| extract "externalID=(?<sensorid>.*?)(?:\s|$)" nodrop
|where if ("{{severity}}" = "*", true, sev matches "{{severity}}") AND if ("{{host_domain}}" = "*", true, host_domain matches "{{host_domain}}") AND if ("{{host}}" = "*", true, host matches "{{host}}") AND if ("{{written_filename}}" = "*", true, written_filename matches "{{written_filename}}") AND if ("{{user}}" = "*", true, user matches "{{user}}") AND if ("{{file}}" = "*", true, file matches "{{file}}")
|count host_domain, sev
| sort _count
| transpose row host_domain column sev
